full_prompt_en: A square cinematic image contains a single narrow horizontal close-up placed along the top portion of a black field. Within the strip, the upper face of a young man with thick dark curls fills the frame from left to right. His eyes are level with the center of the band and look directly outward, while the lower edge cuts through the nose before the mouth can be seen. Loose curls fall over the forehead and break the dark upper border into uneven strands. On the image left, saturated red-orange light covers the hair, eye socket, cheek, and side of the nose, leaving a dark pupil surrounded by warm shadow. The image right is a cold gray-blue, with a brighter glint on the skin beside the nose and a pale reflection in the other eye. The two color regions meet abruptly near the bridge of the nose but still follow the continuous form of one face. Both outer edges sink into darkness, so the gaze is held between dense shadow and a small group of highlights. The surrounding black area has no visible objects or lettering; it makes the thin picture band feel deliberately compressed, like a film frame held in suspense. The close camera distance reveals slight skin texture and damp-looking reflected light, while the background behind the curls remains unidentifiable. Light comes from opposing colored sources at the sides, with deep shadow above and below the eyes. The overall composition is minimal and tense, using a narrow crop and clashing red and blue-gray illumination to concentrate attention on the gaze.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形电影画面在黑色底域上方安置一条狭窄的横向特写。横带内，一位浓密深色卷发年轻男子的上半张脸从左到右填满画幅。双眼与横带中央齐平，直视画外，下边缘在鼻部截断，嘴巴没有出现。松散卷发垂过额头，以不规则发丝打破上方深色边界。画面左侧，浓烈橙红光覆盖头发、眼眶、脸颊及鼻翼，使深瞳处于暖影中。右侧是冷灰蓝色，鼻旁皮肤有较亮的反光，另一只眼中也有浅色光点。两块色域在鼻梁附近突然相接，却仍顺着同一张脸的连续形体变化。左右外缘都沉入暗处，目光被夹在浓影与一小组亮点之间。周围黑色区域没有可见物件或文字；它使细窄画面像一帧被悬置的电影镜头，显得刻意压缩。极近的相机距离显露轻微肤理和似带湿意的反光，卷发后面的背景则无法辨认。光从两侧不同颜色的光源到来，眼睛上下都处在深影中。整体构图极简而紧绷，以窄裁切和冲突的红、蓝灰光把注意力集中在凝视上。
style_prompt_en: The image has a suspenseful cinematic photographic treatment in which nearly black space contains narrow, selectively illuminated forms. Saturated warm red presses against cool blue-gray, with the dividing zone allowed to cut through continuous volume rather than becoming a decorative border. Highlights are small and slightly glossy, while broad surrounding masses lose detail into shadow. Tight cropping removes peripheral context and gives a few sharp focal marks disproportionate weight. Grain and subtle surface variation remain inside the illuminated midtones. Opposing side lights model the forms in separate color temperatures, and dark margins compress the visual field. The overall effect is tense and concentrated, carried by color conflict, close scale, and controlled darkness.
style_prompt_zh: 画面采用带悬念的电影摄影处理，近黑空间只容纳狭窄且有选择地受光的形体。饱和暖红紧挨冷蓝灰，交界处切过连续体积，而非成为装饰边框。高光细小、略带光泽，周围宽大区域则失去细节、隐入阴影。紧密裁切移除外围语境，使少量锐利焦点获得不成比例的分量。受光中间调里仍有颗粒与细微表面变化。来自相对两侧的光以不同色温塑造形体，深色边缘压缩视觉区域。整体效果紧张而集中，依靠色彩冲突、近距离尺度及受控暗部形成。
theme_en: A narrow cinematic close-up of a young man's eyes divided between red and cold light
theme_zh: 一名年轻男子的双眼被红光与冷光分割的狭长电影特写
name: Brian De Palma
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
